description: This Python script implements a web application using Streamlit that allows users to upload various document formats, index them using different language models (Gemini, OpenAI, Custom), and interactively query the indexed documents. It includes functions for setting up service contexts, processing documents, and managing the chat interface.

methods.name: gemini_service_context
methods.description: Sets up a service context using the Gemini language model and GooglePaLMEmbedding, then sets it as the global default.

methods.name: openai_service_context
methods.description: Sets up a service context using the OpenAI GPT-3.5 Turbo model and OpenAIEmbedding, then sets it as the global default.

methods.name: custom_model
methods.description: Sets up a service context combining OpenAI and GooglePaLMEmbedding, then sets it as the global default.

methods.name: process_documents_for_gemini
methods.description: Indexes documents from a directory using Gemini and returns a query engine.

methods.name: process_documents_for_openai
methods.description: Indexes documents from a directory using OpenAI and returns a query engine.

methods.name: process_documents_for_custom
methods.description: Indexes documents from a directory using a custom model setup and returns a query engine.

methods.name: app
methods.description: Main Streamlit application function that manages file uploads, indexing, and chat interactions.
